templates.name: Single-crystal turbine blade
templates.description: Investment-cast single-crystal nickel-superalloy turbine blade, from wax pattern and ceramic shell through vacuum directional solidification, HIP and heat treatment to root machining, EDM cooling holes and an EB-PVD thermal barrier coat. Released on CT, root FPI and flash thermography of the coat; a coating finding loops back to strip and recoat.

templates.name: CFRP wing spar
templates.description: Carbon-fibre wing spar laid up by automated fibre placement from qualified prepreg, vacuum bagged and leak checked, autoclave cured, trimmed and released on ultrasonic C-scan. Drilling and fastening follow, and a final laser-tracker dimensional release sends fastener findings back for re-fastening.

templates.name: Satellite integration and environmental test
templates.description: Assembly, integration and test of a small satellite: subsystems received and harnessed, a baseline functional test, then thermal vacuum, random vibration, and acoustic and EMC campaigns in parallel. templates.name: Titanium airframe bracket, laser powder bed fusion
templates.description: Ti-6Al-4V airframe bracket printed by laser powder bed fusion from qualified powder, stress relieved on the plate and HIPed, then cut off, machined and checked by CT for porosity. A proof load test, surface finishing and FPI come before release on CMM, witness-coupon tensile and resonance results.
